# Blood Cult
The [color=#dc143c]Geometer of Blood[/color], commonly known as the [color=#dc143c]Blood Cult[/color], seeks to summon their elder goddess [color=#dc143c][bold]Nar'Sie[/bold][/color] into this realm.
They practice a single magical branch: [color=#dc143c]Blood Magic[/color].
All cultists have an ability to carve a spell into their own flesh, which they can then perform at will. Some spell invocations include summoning a spare ritual dagger, teleporting to special runes and placing victims in shadow shackles.
All cultists and their constructs have access to a collective mind, use [color=#dc143c]+c[/color] to communicate in it.
## Goal
In order to summon [color=#dc143c]Nar'Sie[/color]'s dark avatar, the cult needs to invoke the [color=#dc143c]Rune of Dimensional Rending[/color].
This rune can only be drawn in a [bold]ritual site[/bold] explained below, after a special target has been sacrificed.
This target is shown in your objectives and is picked randomly when starting the cult.
In order to get strong enough to do this, and even invoke the rune, you will need at least 9 cult members.
Use the [color=#dc143c]Rune of Offering[/color] to convert or sacrifice crew, soulless ones will become a soul shard for use in constructs. Living converts will be healed a bit too incase you had to crit them.
## Leader
One of the cultists is the [color=#dc143c]Leader[/color], who is in charge of commanding the other members.
Defer to the leader on important decisions like where to attack, where to build your main cult base or where to summon [color=#dc143c]Nar'Sie[/color].
## Spells
Spells are obtained by carving your flesh with the [italic]Prepare Spell[/italic] ability.
They will require you to spill some blood, have a medibot on standby.
Usually you can only have 1 spell queued up, if you are empowered you can have [bold]4[/bold] instead, and they are much faster to prepare.
[bold]Using spells is very obvious, don't use them in public if you don't want to be revealed![/bold]
[textlink="See the full list of spells here" link="BloodCultSpells"/]
## Runes
Runes are a more powerful magic that require spilling your blood then carving it into a unique eldritch symbol.
Some of the basic runes can be used solo, but the powerful runes will require multiple cultists nearby to help you invoke it.
[textlink="See the full list of runes here" link="BloodCultRunes"/]
The most important runes required for the cult to summon [color=#dc143c]Nar'Sie[/color] are: - Offering, so you can grow your cult's numbers and sacrifice the target. - Dimensional Rending, which brings Her into your dimension.
## Ritual Sites
Ritual Sites are a randomly picked of areas on the station where the veil of reality is weakest.
You can see all available ritual sites in your objectives.
These sites are the only locations you can draw the runes of [color=#dc143c]Apocalypse[/color] and [color=#dc143c]Dimensional Rending[/color].
Once you draw these unique runes, that ritual site cannot be used for another rune. Choose wisely.
